summary: Created B2.3 Frontend Acceptance Closure with Storybook, deterministic E2E, stability, accessibility, bundle, and evidence boundaries.
Baselined spec v1.0 and execution packet before implementation; commit, merge, release, and self-approval remain forbidden.
Aligned Storybook 10.5.8, localized shared close controls, stabilized the observed UI tests, optimized cron scanning, and added bundle and isolated browser acceptance gates.

Storybook, isolated two-viewport Playwright, 481-file UI suite, focused 96-test suite, workspace typecheck, production build, bundle budget, token gates, brand gates, locale parity, and diff checks passed. The repository-wide suite retained 27 unrelated environment-sensitive failures.
Inspected desktop and narrow-desktop Project Targets and Legacy Work screenshots; no incoherent overlap, clipped controls, or broken layout was found.
B2.3 acceptance evidence is complete. The uncommitted B2 working tree is a frontend merge candidate pending independent review and maintainer treatment of the inherited repository-wide test baseline.

Hardened the final browser evidence with active-tab, completed-response, and skeleton-dismissal conditions; verified final desktop and narrow-desktop screenshots; scoped Vite dependency discovery away from generated Storybook HTML; and confirmed automatic temporary-home cleanup.

Separated ignored reusable Playwright output from explicitly frozen delivery evidence, moved temporary-home ownership to an outer cleanup runner, enforced browser and bundle checks in PR and release verification, regenerated and visually inspected evidence, and confirmed a normal rerun cannot mutate frozen hashes. No scoped merge blocker survives.
